title: Model magic item summoning and controlled-entity lifecycles (M4)
description: Implement family M4 from docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/2026-07-06-o9bd-18-7-7-3-magic-item-mechanics-inventory.md §4: 17 rows (exact list in artifact; flagship figurine-of-wondrous-power; also bag-of-tricks, elemental-command bowls/brazier/censer/stone, efreeti-bottle, elemental-gem, feather-token bird/whip, horn-of-valhalla, iron-flask, manual-of-golems, pipes-of-the-sewers, ring-of-djinni-summoning, staff-of-the-python, deck-of-illusions). Shape: creature/statBlock ref + control mode (obedient/friendly/contest/disobedience-chance) + duration + revert/cooldown + death-of-entity consequences (staff-of-the-python shatters; djinni ring goes nonmagical). KEY DESIGN BOUNDARY: pack data (what can be summoned, durations, cooldowns) vs live session state (the summoned combatant instance) — reuse encounter combatant state; do not put live state in the pack. Contest/reuse existing exclusiveInstance-style contracts from 18.7.9 where source semantics match (do NOT collapse distinct recast semantics — see PR #399 review findings). Recommended agent: Opus 4.8 design, Codex rollout.
notes:
2026-07-08 ADR 0017 adjustment: Summoning work should separate pack-side summonable/entity/control/duration/reversion contracts from live summoned-combatant instances and encounter state. Engine or campaign-state behavior should be named as hooks/owners; do not store mutable summoned state in generated records.
Implemented the source-grounded family projector, strict schema validation, clause registry bindings, generated pack projection, and representative/exhaustive tests. The exact 240-row owner-tag conservation census passes; all magic items now carry reviewed executable mechanics.
close_reason: Source-faithful executable magic-item family complete; canonical regeneration, conservation gates, deep audit, and full worktree verification pass.
